sections.beforeHtml: In Plantour, the dictionary is the place where you keep a list of reusable entities that is not tied to one specific trip. It includes travelers, items, bags, and todos, so you can copy them into trips instead of creating them from scratch each time. After signing in you can manage these dictionaries here:
paragraphs: Travelers stores the people you can reuse across different trips.
Items stores reusable things you may want to pack for multiple trips.
Bags stores reusable bags or containers that can be added to trips.
Todos stores reusable tasks you may need to complete for different trips.
sections.afterHtml: You can navigate to a certain dictionary by clicking on toolbar`s "Dashboard" button, expand "Dictionary" section and then select a corresponding link.
